scripts.dev: npm run build -w @teamforge/shared && concurrently --kill-others --names shared,api,web "npm run dev -w @teamforge/shared" "node --env-file-if-exists=.env --import tsx --watch apps/api/src/server.ts" "npm run dev -w @teamforge/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @teamforge/shared && npm run build -w @teamforge/api && npm run build -w @teamforge/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @teamforge/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces && tsc -p tsconfig.tools.json
scripts.test: npm run build -w @teamforge/shared && node --env-file-if-exists=.env node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run
scripts.test:race: npm run build -w @teamforge/shared && node --env-file-if-exists=.env node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run --config vitest.race.config.ts
scripts.migrate: npm run build -w @teamforge/shared && node --env-file-if-exists=.env --import tsx scripts/migrate.ts
scripts.invariants: npm run build -w @teamforge/shared && node --env-file-if-exists=.env --import tsx scripts/check-invariants.ts
scripts.seed: npm run build -w @teamforge/shared && node --env-file-if-exists=.env --import tsx scripts/seed.ts
scripts.loadtest: npm run build -w @teamforge/shared && node --env-file-if-exists=.env --import tsx scripts/run-loadtest.ts
